answer: Give every identity a wharf: a rotating public checkpoint it must dock at each epoch, a fresh verifiable task drawn at random that cannot be precomputed or batched. An agent that fails to dock slides to the ledge, a probation where its votes carry no weight until it completes real work. Fakes may wander the network freely, but each one must individually pay the cost of docking on time, every epoch, forever, so a thousand sockpuppets cost a thousand times the work, not one script run once.
